positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
•	Lead project to modernize a capacity optimization system used within Amazon warehouses to minimize order shipment delays and fulfillment cost. Designed the high-level architecture and guided other engineers on the team through low-level component design. Worked on implementation as well on the AWS implementation that utilized ECS/Fargate, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, and IAM for periodic batch workflows along with highly-available APIs.
•	Implemented and refined linear program using the FICO Xpress library in collaboration with a research scientist.
•	Designed and built full-stack single-page application (SPA) web application running in AWS to visualize, deep-dive, and manage above service that is used by both both developers and end-users that leveraged CloudFront, S3, API Gateway, and Lambda and used React on the frontend.
•	Wrote strategy and design documents for team and org-level ideas/initiatives for yearly planning and project proposals.
•	Acted as team lead and mentor by providing mentorship, guidance, code reviews, document reviews, and working with non-dev stakeholders to keep the overall team on track.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
• Designed data pipeline for ingesting geospatial data to support Amazon’s last mile expansion into Japan and other regions. Leveraged Apache Spark.
• Built internal web application for (1) tracking the provenance and inter-dependency of geospatial data sets and pipelines and (2) allowing users to monitor and alarm on data staleness or SLA breaches. React-based single-page application with a GraphQL backend built using AWS CloudFront, S3, and API Gateway.

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed a search microservice allowing users to more efficiently query data and generate arbitrary reports utilizing Apache Solr and ASP.NET.
•	Built the frontend UI/UX for an advanced search and report workflow using Angular and TypeScript for an online portfolio and internal CRM applications eliminating the need for manually exporting data and generating reports.
•	Re-designed an analytics workflow and dashboard that allows users to perform what-if analysis.  Improved report times to less than a minute from over 10 minutes. Used Angular, ASP.NET, and an Oracle database.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented a product configuration and quoting REST API using C# and ASP.NET Core along with a TypeScript frontend using React. 
•	Led a project to create a single-page application for configuring and quoting products for sales reps, which reduced quoting time down to a few minutes from several days. Used AngularJS.
•	Setup a continuous-integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipeline using Jenkins for the team.
•	Piloted a project for using Docker to reduce differences between test and production environments.

positions.title: Junior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Supported a multi-threaded C firmware program for vehicle performance tuning that ran on in-house hardware.
•	Created a demo version of the main product firmware program for the sales team to use.
•	Designed and implemented a C# desktop GUI application to ease debugging binary files generated by the firmware program.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: •	Developed a JavaScript web application for simulating electromagnetic scattering for educational purposes.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: •	Created a web application to generate automated reports about the plant’s operation for supervisors, removing the need to manually generate the reports. Used C# and ASP.NET 4.
